C-31.Name: Run the C-30 WebKit large-document perf gate in CI
C-31.Summary: C-30 added tests/e2e/perf/large-doc-webkit.spec.ts (webkit-perf project) but CI installs Chromium only and runs the chromium project, so a regression of the WebKit O(n²) lexer cost would only be caught by someone running `npm run test:e2e:perf` locally. Wire the gate into the renderer-e2e job of .github/workflows/test.yml.

Problem.Description: The only engine Mark ships on macOS (WKWebView) is not exercised by any CI job; the perf gate is opt-in.
Problem.RootCause: C-30 scope deliberately excluded workflow changes; CI provisions Chromium only.
Problem.Evidence: .github/workflows/test.yml renderer-e2e: `npx playwright install chromium --with-deps`, `npm run test:e2e` (= --project chromium).

Goals.R-1: renderer-e2e installs Playwright WebKit next to Chromium (same browser cache) and runs `npx playwright test --project webkit-perf` against the build the job already produces, as a separate step after the chromium suite.
Goals.R-2: Failure artifacts (playwright-report) cover the perf step too.
Goals.R-3: Stale header comment of test.yml (counts, e2e scope) reflects the WebKit perf gate.

Constraints.Constraint: No change to release.yml (release gating stays chromium-only; the perf gate belongs to the per-push test workflow).
Reuse the job's `npm run build` output; do not call `npm run test:e2e:perf` (it rebuilds).
Budget and retry policy stay as defined in the spec (3 s, one retry).

NonGoals.NonGoal: Running the full e2e suite in WebKit.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: test.yml parses (actionlint or yaml load) and the renderer-e2e job contains the WebKit install and webkit-perf steps after the chromium suite.
Locally, the exact CI command sequence (build, install webkit, `npx playwright test --project webkit-perf`) passes.
First CI run on push is observed green before any tag (no push/tag without explicit user approval).

AffectedAreas.M-011: V-M-011 command note: perf gate now runs in CI test.yml renderer-e2e

C-31.VerificationIntent: YAML validation + local replay of the CI step sequence; CI observation after the user-approved push.
